title: Runaway
html_source: There are versions of the story in which she runs away, and versions in which she is kidnapped, but Deasy has an opinion on which one is correct.

anchor.prefix: — I am happier than you are, he said. We have committed many errors and many sins. A woman brought sin into the world. For a woman who was no better than she should be, Helen, the
anchor.suffix: wife of Menelaus, ten years the Greeks made war on Troy. A faithless wife first brought the strangers 1961#34to our shore here, MacMurrough's wife and her leman, O'Rourke, prince
